notes.title: Patch 0.6.1
notes.notes:
Just a few quality of life changes:

Turtles now pick you up when walking into them rather than pushing you away.

Slow of the Revealer builds up much faster (scales with Revealer level).

Europe west server has been temporarily disabled due to high latency issues.

Bugfixes.

notes.title: Update 0.6.0
notes.notes:
Wind Blade now has a streak system
Attacking builds up a streak:

1st Attack: Dash forward, knocking up enemies you pass through.

2nd Attack: Perform a slash that knocks away enemies.

3rd Attack: Summon a tornado that knocks up enemies hit.



Charging the dash (hold LMB) is now a lot faster to allow for smoother combos.

Combine knock-up attacks with Wind Vortex (hold RMB) to smash enemies into the ground to cause more fall damage!



Have fun! (Available in Demo)

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1
notes.notes:
New 

The Revealer now also reveals footprints.

Ghosts can now be banished by sneaking on top of them, revealing the player and their footprints.

Being invisible builds up Armor. Becoming visible removes the Armor partially over time. Being revealed removes all Armor immediately.

Changes 

The Revealer can now be automatically shot with one button (including weapon swapping).

Improved UI for invisibility.

Bugfixes.

notes.title: Update 0.5.0
notes.notes:
Bomb defusal is here!New Game mode
Players are split into terrorists planting a bomb and counter-terrorists trying to stop them. Victory comes from either detonating/defusing the bomb or eliminating the opposing team.


Miscellaneous
Thunderwand has improved VFX

Performance improvements

Bugfixes and polish

notes.title: Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
New fancy magic weapon and more!
Rune Scepter is a primary weapon for people that love combining spells.

LMB: Charge one RED (+damage) stack.
RMB: Charge one BLUE (+reveal duration) stack.
At 3 charges, cast the spell assigned to this specific order of colors. You can cast spells from a range of 8 different spells:

Leap
Barrage
Boomerang
Shield
Slash
Gravity Burst
Buff
Slow Area

The game now also features a Chat and improved player feedback for cooldowns.

notes.title: Update 0.3.0
notes.notes:
Improved graphics, new maps and other features!
The game now features a more refined, artistic style that enhances the gameplay’s atmosphere, along with many other improvements.

Some of these features include:

Layout changes for different maps
Tutorial
Detailed description for all equipment
Map recommendation system
Climbing ladders
Improved spread algorithm
More fun game settings like time scale, global damage factor, etc.

notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
Networking Update!
The whole networking layer has been replaced from a Host - Client model to Distributed Authority, meaning there will no longer be a host, and everyone plays as Client instead. The connection is established over a light weight relay server, so your IP address will remain hidden.

Distributed Authority has the following benefits over the traditional Host - Client model:

 ~50% lower latency between Clients.
 No more unfair Host-advantage.
 Client to Client connection isn't dependent on the internet speed of one Host.
 Network workload is better spread amongst all players.
